item.title: Norah O'Donnell: 7 things I learned from trainer Kira Stokes
item.description: Kira Stokes, who has been in the fitness industry for three decades, taught me to treat movement as medicine for both your body and mind.

item.title: SpaceX rocket booster slams into moon, expected to leave large crater
item.description: The impact wasn't visible to the naked eye, but photos are expected to come from a lunar satellite at a later time.

item.title: SpaceX rocket accidentally collides with moon
item.description: A SpaceX rocket accidentally slammed into the moon early Wednesday. The crater it created could be 100 feet wide and 16 feet deep. Mark Strassmann has more.

item.title: Rep. Chuck Edwards drops reelection bid after sexual harassment allegations
item.description: The House Ethics Committee said there is "substantial reason to believe" Rep. Chuck Edwards violated House rules related to sexual harassment and hostile workplaces. Edwards denied any wrongdoing.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy speaks to judge for first time during her murder trial
item.description: In court on Tuesday, Lindsay Clancy spoke for the first time as she agreed to a "stipulation of facts" that would fast-track her trial. Her lawyers claim she was mentally ill and not responsible for her actions when she killed her three young children. Shanelle Kaul reports.

item.title: Trump has privately expressed hope Rep. Max Miller drops reelection bid, sources say
item.description: Ohio Republican Rep. Max Miller says he is staying in his reelection race even as pressure mounts for him to step aside over domestic abuse allegations. President Trump has privately expressed hope that Miller drops out, sources say. Caitlin Huey-Burns reports.

item.title: Wildfires burning in Washington state could worsen
item.description: Three wildfires near Spokane, Washington, are still burning out of control after destroying hundreds of buildings. Now there are new fears the fires could worsen due to weather conditions. Kris Van Cleave reports.

item.title: Video shows drone attacking a street vendor in Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says the footage shows how Russian soldiers "take pleasure in killing" civilians.

item.title: Former Virginia Gov. Youngkin launches new conservative policy group
item.description: The group, called Empowering America's Parents, will focus on expanding awareness about the Education Freedom Tax Credit.

item.title: Man carrying ammunition arrested at Trump golf course in California
item.description: Investigators say a man was arrested after he brought a loaded gun and ammunition to the Trump National Golf Club in California, gave a false identity and was seen recording preparations for President Trump's upcoming visit. Nicole Sganga has more.

item.title: Eye Opener: Latest on key Michigan primary race
item.description: A key primary race in Michigan could help to determine the balance of power in the Senate in November. Plus, a man with weapons and ammunition in his car is arrested at a Trump golf course ahead of the president's visit. All that and all that matters in today's Eye Opener.

item.title: White House declassifies info on secret FBI probe into Trump's firing of Comey
item.description: The White House has declassified information claiming the FBI probed whether President Trump acted as a Russian asset when he fired James Comey, a theory an administration official said wasn't backed up by evidence.

item.title: Perez Hilton hospitalized after livestreaming acts of self-harm, officials say
item.description: In the livestream, which has since been taken down, Hilton appears to be bloodied and in a distressed mental state.

item.title: SpaceX shows strong growth in its first earnings report since IPO
item.description: Elon Musk's rocket, satellite and AI provider reported quarterly revenue of $7.8 billion, topping Wall Street forecasts.

item.title: Trump says Strait of Hormuz deal could happen as soon as today amid talks
item.description: President Trump told reporters Tuesday evening that an announcement on the Strait of Hormuz could happen today or tomorrow, following talks between Iran and Oman.

item.title: Progress made in Strait of Hormuz talks, Rubio says
item.description: The secretary of state said progress has been made in the Iran-Oman talks but that no final agreement has been reached, adding, "We're hoping that ‌will happen very ‌shortly."

item.title: Exercise: Your Insurance Policy for the Future
item.description: In this episode of Healthful, Norah O'Donnell is joined by her personal trainer and fitness expert, Kira Stokes. Since they started exercising together 12 years ago, Kira pushed Norah to lift heavier weights - something Norah initially resisted. Norah has since learned that you lose up to 8-percent of your muscle mass every decade after the age of 30. The two discuss the emotional connection between movement and mental health, how to get started exercising, and what about those weighted vests! Plus - Norah answers what her favorite and least favorite exercises are. We'd love to hear what topics you want to hear covered on Healthful. Text Norah at 202-217-1107.

item.title: Popular influencer shot dead during livestream outside restaurant
item.description: Cesar Gastelum, who had more than 600,000 followers on TikTok, was broadcasting with two friends when he was killed.

item.title: House Democrats targeting 12 new GOP districts, including Lauren Boebert's seat
item.description: With 90 days until the midterm elections, House Democrats are expanding the map of Republican-held congressional districts they believe they can potentially flip this fall.

item.title: Pills from Lindsay Clancy's house examined on Day 6 of murder trial
item.description: The Lindsay Clancy murder trial resumed for a sixth day Tuesday with more testimony from prosecution witnesses and a focus on prescription pills.

item.title: El-Sayed holds narrow lead in tight Michigan Democratic Senate primary race
item.description: Tuesday's Michigan Democratic Senate primary race remains unsettled, with progressive Abdul El-Sayed holding onto a narrow lead over moderate Haley Stevens with votes still being counted.

item.title: Man carrying ammunition arrested near Trump National Golf Club before president's visit
item.description: Federal authorities arrested a man who appeared to be monitoring security-planning activities at Trump National Golf Club in LA County ahead of the president's Southern California visit.

item.title: Democratic Rep. Gluesenkamp Perez and Trump-backed Republican advance in Washington primary
item.description: Democratic Rep. Marie Gluesenkamp Perez and Republican state Sen. John Braun will advance to a general election in Washington's 3rd District, one of the most hotly contested House contests of this year, CBS News projects.

item.title: Bezos, Leonardo DiCaprio set up $200 million wildlife fund to save species on brink of extinction
item.description: Hollywood actor Leonardo DiCaprio and Amazon founder Jeff Bezos have announced a $200 million fund set to protect species on the brink of extinction. Carter Evans has the story.

item.title: House Ethics probing Rep. Max Miller for alleged domestic violence, drug use
item.description: The House Ethics Committee announced that it is opening a probe into allegations that Rep. Max Miller may have engaged in domestic violence or drug use.

item.title: Chipotle removes jalapeños linked to Minnesota salmonella outbreak
item.description: The restaurant chain said it pulled the peppers and replaced them with product from another grower amid a food-poisoning probe.

item.title: Salmonella outbreak possibly linked to Chipotle jalapeños under investigation in Minnesota
item.description: At least 110 people have fallen ill from salmonella in Minnesota, the vast majority of whom reported having eaten at the Mexican chain Chipotle. Tom Hanson has the story.

item.title: Idaho In-N-Out shooting victims remembered by loved ones: "She lit up a room"
item.description: Three people were killed and seven others were wounded in the Saturday attack in Twin Falls, Idaho. The gunman died of a self-inflicted gunshot wound, officials said.

item.title: FBI not conducting civil rights probe into ICE shooting in Maine, sources say
item.description: The deadly encounter between an ICE officer and Johan Sebastián Durán Guerrero on July 13 in Biddeford, Maine, is the latest in a growing string of clashes between civilians and ICE agents.

item.title: Nazi warships, mammoth bones emerge as Danube River dries up
item.description: Water levels on the Danube River have dropped so low that dozens of World War II German battleships – and even the remains of an ancient woolly mammoth — are emerging into view.
